High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench, Nagpur

sentences.text:
Ms Aparna Kshirsagar, Advocate h/f Shri K.R. Bhise, Advocat
 for applicant.
Ms M.R. Kavimandan, Agp / App for respondent/State.

The applicant apprehends his arrest in connection
 with Crime No.531/2025 registered with Police Station,
 Ganeshpeth, District Nagpur (City) for t
 punishable under Sections 123, 223, 274 and 275 of the
 Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and Sections 26(2) (iv),
27(3)(e), 30(2)(a), 3(1)(zz)(iv) and 59 of the Food Safety
 and Standards Act, 2006.

2. The contention of the learned counsel for the
 applicant is that contraband articles viz. scented tobacco are
 already recovered and the applicant is unconcerned with the
 premises at Nagpur and he is a Manager of Hans Travels at
 Raipur.
4. Ms Kavimandan, APP waives service of notice on  behalf of the non-applicant and prays for time to file reply.
At her request, stand over to 03.02.2026.
6. Considering the fact that the contraband scented  tobacco is already recovered, a case is made out for ad  interim anticipatory bail.

Hence, the following order :

1  ORDER 7.

sentences.text: In the event of arrest, the applicant - Mohammad Sohail S/o Mohammad Shakir in connection with Crime No.531/2025 registered with Police Station, Ganeshpeth, District Nagpur (City) be released on ad interim anticipatory bail on executing PR bond of 25,000/- with one solvent surety in the like amount.
8. The applicant shall attend the concerned police station on 27th, 28th and 30th January 2026 between 10.00 am to 02.00 pm.
